# Documents

This folder contains the raw extracted text chunks from the Atrieflimren i Danmark (AFDK) annual reports for 2023, 2024, and 2025. These pages preserve the verbatim data, tables, and prose from the original PDFs, covering national and regional quality indicator results (such as anticoagulation wait times, echocardiography rates, and stroke incidence), data background methodologies, calculation rules, steering group memberships, and supplementary analyses. They serve as the foundational source material from which all entities, topics, and claims in this wiki are derived and cited.
